Services

Mechanic and body, one roof

Every service below is on the shop's own listing or lettered on its own storefront glass. Tap a card for more.

General MechanicRepairs and maintenance+
The mechanical side of the shop: diagnostics and repair, oil changes, brakes and tune-ups, all on the storefront's own list.
Auto BodyCollision and paint+
Body work and insurance jobs, from panel replacement to paint. The before-and-after pair in the work section below came out of this bay.
InspectionsState + PA emissions CM65+
State inspections off the window list, and emissions testing as an official Drive Clean PA station, CM65, on the Commonwealth's own station list.
Tires & AlignmentNew and used tires+
New and used tires plus alignments, both in the shop's own published description.
TowingOn the window list+
Towing is lettered on the shop's glass and in its listing categories. If the car cannot get to Cameron St on its own, call the shop first.
Notary ServicesAnd more, per the shop+
Notary services are in the shop's own description of itself, alongside the mechanic and body work. One stop, as the name says.
